payload.title: Knowledge-query OpenAI key: fall back to shared SSM path
payload.description: Semantic search failed with ParameterNotFound: knowledge-query used only path from AMPLIFY_SSM_ENV_CONFIG; key lives at sharedPath. Fix in PR #1082 (path, then sharedPath on ParameterNotFound only). Same single-path pattern remains in src/papyrus_content/amplify_ssm_secrets.py:65 and amplify/functions/shared/amplify-secrets.ts:55.
